name: @eventiva/eventiva
description: Eventiva workspace: portable Effect contracts, the backend runtime, Expo client and server shells.

scripts.check: node tools/toolchain/versions.mjs --check && node tools/dev/surfaces.mjs check && node tools/license/check-headers.mjs && node tools/ai-docs/docgen.mjs --check && node tools/storage/policy.mjs && node --test tools/storage/guard.test.mjs && node tools/references/check.mjs && node --test tools/references/check.test.mjs tools/test-process/check.test.mjs tools/verification/pipeline.test.mjs tools/comments/ratchet.test.mjs && node tools/comments/ratchet.mjs --base HEAD && node --run documentation
scripts.documentation: node --test tools/documentation/check.test.mjs tools/documentation/jsdoc-tags.test.mjs tools/documentation/ratchet.test.mjs tools/documentation/linear-mirror.test.mjs tools/documentation/sync-linear.test.mjs tools/documentation/planning.test.mjs && node tools/documentation/linear-mirror.mjs --check && node tools/documentation/planning.mjs --check && node tools/documentation/ratchet.mjs --base HEAD && node tools/documentation/check.mjs
scripts.verify:static: nx run-many -t build && nx run-many -t lint typecheck && node tools/resources/boundaries.mjs && node tools/resources/boundaries.mjs --declarations
